notes: 📅 Pending orders can change their expiry. Every order card gains an expiry button beside the price editor: give it a number of days (45) or a date (26/10/2026), and the unfilled order waits that long before cancelling itself and returning the reserved cash. Must be at least tomorrow, a year at most. Previously the only way was cancel-and-replace, which threw away the order’s cheapest-since-ordered tracking.
